content.title: About
content.content: Mountain Dew AMP is an energy drink produced by PepsiCo. It contains caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins, and sugar, delivering a quick boost of energy and heightened focus. The flavor blends citrus notes with a mild sweetness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: AMP was first launched in 2001 as a response to the growing energy‑drink market.
The drink provides about 32 mg of caffeine per 100 ml, roughly 80 mg in a standard 250 ml can.
The brand frequently partners with esports teams and music festivals.
In some countries the formula is altered to reduce sugar and add artificial sweeteners.
Packaging often features bright neon colors to emphasize its high‑energy image.

items.title: Increased alertness
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, improving attention and reaction time.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: B‑vitamins (B3, B6, B12) play key roles in cellular energy metabolism.

items.title: Enhanced physical endurance
items.content: Taurine may help muscles use energy more efficiently.

items.title: Excessive caffeine intake
items.content: High doses can cause anxiety, insomnia, and rapid heart rate.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Regular consumption may contribute to weight gain and elevated blood glucose.

items.title: Not recommended for children and pregnant women
items.content: Due to the high level of stimulants, these groups should limit consumption.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink AMP chilled, straight from the can. It is recommended not to exceed one 250 ml can within a 4‑hour period. Do not mix with alcohol.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 24 hours.
